title: Technology Associate, Data Engineering
summary: 3+ years developing, optimizing, maintaining, and modernizing enterprise ETL pipelines in a Cloudera Hadoop environment — from a config-driven PySpark framework to a legacy warehouse migration.

categories.title: ETL & Pipeline Engineering
bullets: Developed and optimized 15+ complex ETL workflows implementing business logic, data transformations, and validation rules using Informatica BDM, HiveQL, Impala SQL, PySpark, and shell scripting in Cloudera Hadoop environments.
Created and optimized daily, monthly, quarterly, and custom-date ETL workflows with configurable runtime parameters and partition-based loading logic.

Developed reusable config-driven PySpark ETL frameworks with dynamic configuration handling, validation and reconciliation logic, flexible batch processing capabilities, and Bash scripts for PySpark job execution.
Optimized HiveQL and Impala SQL queries for compatibility, performance, scalability, and large-scale batch processing requirements.

categories.title: Migration & Modernization
bullets: Modernized 15+ enterprise reporting datasets from Netezza/Cognos to Hadoop-based ETL workflows using HiveQL and Informatica BDM, ensuring data consistency and reliable downstream reporting.
Independently delivered multiple end-to-end ETL and migration projects involving query conversion, workflow development, validation, UAT support, and deployment activities.

categories.title: Production Reliability
bullets: Analyzed and resolved complex data quality and transformation issues in enterprise reporting pipelines by identifying root causes in HiveQL/Informatica ETL logic and implementing validated production fixes.
Implemented complex business rule enhancements, derived columns, workflow redesigns, and reporting improvements across large-scale data pipelines while meeting defined SLA commitments.

Performed RCA and pipeline-level debugging for complex data issues across multi-stage ETL workflows, resolving data mismatches, transformation issues, and production defects across enterprise reporting pipelines.

categories.title: Delivery & Collaboration
bullets: Collaborated with business users, development teams, production teams, and stakeholders during requirement clarification, UAT validation, release cycles, and production deployments.
Mentored new team members on pipeline concepts and codebase practices, guiding their contributions through review and lead approval before production release.
Led execution of a few multi-developer projects from development through delivery, coordinating work across the team.
